steps.label: up
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && : > up6.res; for i in $(seq 1 30); do [ -f up/up6.txt ] && [ -f up/bk_thumb2.jpg ] && break; sleep 10; done; while read f t u; do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H "Content-Type: $t" -H 'If-None-Match: *' -T "$f" "$u"); echo "$f $c" >> up6.res; done < up/up6.txt; echo fertig >> up6.res; cat up6.res
